brief.meaningEn: Travel between two places, especially when discussing the practical journey.
brief.meaningZh: 從一個地方前往另一個地方，重點是實際行程。
brief.grammar: getting from A to B; get from A to B; got from A to B.
brief.register: Neutral shorthand for travel logistics; A and B stand for places, not named people.
brief.boundaryZh: 須談論兩地之間如何移動；不是比較選項 A 和 B 的文字標籤。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把 A 和 B 當成必須叫這兩個字母的地名。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用這個片語討論路線、轉乘與出行難易。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 5, row 5; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The new route makes getting from A to B much easier.

listening.en: The new bus route cuts out a transfer, so getting from A to B across town is much easier now.
listening.zh: 新巴士路線省卻一次轉乘，所以現在穿越市區，從一處到另一處容易得多。

options.en: It makes travelling between places simpler.
options.zh: 它令兩地之間的出行較簡單。

options.en: It mainly lowers the fare without changing the route.
options.zh: 它主要降低車費，卻沒有改變路線。

options.en: It shortens the wait but keeps the same transfer.
options.zh: 它縮短等車時間，但轉乘次數不變。

options.en: It adds an extra transfer across town.
options.zh: 它令穿越市區的旅程多一次轉乘。

listening.explanationZh: 新路線省卻一次轉乘，令兩地之間的旅程更容易；沒有資料顯示車費或候車時間改變。

reply.promptEn: What would help visitors travel between the two exhibition buildings?
reply.promptZh: （甚麼能幫助訪客從一座展覽大樓前往另一座？）

options.en: A clear map would make getting from A to B easier.
options.zh: 清晰的地圖會令訪客從一座大樓前往另一座更容易。

options.en: A short shuttle would save them a long walk.
options.zh: 短程接駁車能省卻漫長步行。

options.en: Signs at both exits would point them the right way.
options.zh: 兩邊出口的指示牌能指引正確方向。

options.en: Staff could explain which entrance is closer to each display.
options.zh: 職員可以解釋哪個入口較接近各個展區。

reply.explanationZh: 四項都能幫助訪客從一座大樓前往另一座；金句使用本課片語，概括從起點到終點的旅程。

scene.promptZh: 兩座場館原本要轉乘兩次。主辦方增設直達接駁車。哪句最準確描述改動的作用？

options.en: The shuttle makes getting from A to B more straightforward.
options.zh: 接駁車令從一座場館前往另一座更直接。

options.en: Visitors now need two additional transfers to reach the second venue.
options.zh: 訪客現在要額外轉乘兩次，才能到第二個場館。

options.en: Visitors still need to change vehicles twice, though the fare is lower.
options.zh: 訪客仍須轉乘兩次，只是車費較低。

scene.explanationZh: 直達接駁車減少轉乘，改善實際交通；另外兩句都聲稱仍要轉車，與情境不符。

contrast.promptZh: 以本課「兩地之間的實際行程」的意思，哪個情況最不適合說 getting from A to B？

options.en: A cyclist asks which bridge connects the two districts.
options.zh: 單車騎士查問哪座橋連接兩個地區。

options.en: A teacher compares answer choice A with answer choice B on a worksheet.
options.zh: 老師比較工作紙上的 A 和 B 兩個答案選項。

options.en: A traveller checks how long it takes to reach the harbour from the station.
options.zh: 旅客查問從車站到碼頭需時多久。

contrast.explanationZh: 比較工作紙的答案選項不涉及前往兩地；另外兩項都是路線或交通問題。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「車站與音樂廳相隔兩條街，但我不熟悉這一帶。」哪個回應最有幫助？

options.en: This map makes getting from A to B easier on foot; follow the marked crossing.
options.zh: 這張地圖讓你更容易步行從車站前往音樂廳；沿着標示的行人過路處走吧。

options.en: Do not check a route; simply guess at every junction.
options.zh: 不用查路線；每個路口都隨便猜吧。

options.en: The streets are close, so signs and crossings cannot matter.
options.zh: 兩條街很近，所以指示牌和行人過路處都不重要。

dialogue.explanationZh: 地圖與過路處直接解決陌生地區的步行路線問題；其餘建議忽視實際導航。

speaking.en: A simple walking map made getting from A to B easier for new visitors.
speaking.zh: 簡單的步行地圖讓初次到訪的人更容易從起點走到目的地。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明步行地圖怎樣幫助初次到訪的人。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學校活動分別在主校舍與體育館舉行，新同學不懂兩地之間怎樣走。用一至兩句英文介紹你會提供甚麼幫助。
writing.selfCheckZh: 說明兩地之間的出行問題，以及地圖或指示牌等具體幫助；不要只談論課室名稱。

examples.en: A marked map will make getting from A to B easier for new students. We can show the safest crossing.
examples.zh: 有標記的地圖會令新同學從主校舍前往體育館更容易。我們可以指出最安全的行人過路處。

examples.en: Getting from A to B takes about five minutes on foot, so I will put clear signs beside both entrances.
examples.zh: 兩地之間步行約需五分鐘，所以我會在兩邊入口旁放置清晰的指示牌。

takeaways.en: Getting from A to B took longer when the footbridge was closed.
takeaways.zh: 行人天橋關閉後，從一處前往另一處要更久。

takeaways.en: The guide explained how to get from A to B without changing trains.
takeaways.zh: 導遊解釋了如何不轉車便從一處到另一處。

notes: AI-authored first pass; independent editorial and release checks have not occurred.

brief.meaningEn: Have more time than needed before a deadline or event.
brief.meaningZh: 在限期或活動開始前，仍有超過所需的時間。
brief.grammar: arrive with time to spare; finish with time to spare.
brief.register: Everyday neutral expression for a margin of time.
brief.boundaryZh: 須真的比所需時間早完成或到達；剛好準時並沒有額外時間。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把片語當成「沒有事情做」的一整天閒暇。
brief.outcomeZh: 能判斷何時一項行程或工作留有充裕時間。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 5, row 6; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: We reached the gate with time to spare.

listening.en: We reached the cinema twenty minutes before the film began, so we had time to spare.
listening.zh: 電影開場前二十分鐘，我們已到達戲院，所以還有充裕時間。
listening.promptZh: 說話者到達戲院時，時間情況如何？

options.en: They had extra time before the film.
options.zh: 電影開始前，他們還有多出的時間。

options.en: They arrived just as the film ended.
options.zh: 他們在電影結束時才到。

options.en: They had no time to buy a ticket.
options.zh: 他們沒有時間買票。

options.en: The film was delayed by twenty minutes.
options.zh: 電影延遲了二十分鐘。

listening.explanationZh: 提前二十分鐘到達表示開場前有多出的時間；題目沒有說電影延期。

reply.promptEn: Why did you take the earlier train to the museum?
reply.promptZh: （你為何乘較早的火車去博物館？）

options.en: I wanted to arrive with time to spare before our booked tour.
options.zh: 我想在預約導賞開始前提早到達，留有充裕時間。

options.en: The earlier train gave me a safer margin if a connection was slow.
options.zh: 若轉車稍慢，較早的火車仍能給我較充裕的時間。

options.en: I hoped to find the entrance before the group gathered.
options.zh: 我希望在小組集合前找到入口。

options.en: I wanted a little time to read the visitor information.
options.zh: 我想留點時間閱讀訪客資訊。

reply.explanationZh: 四個回答都能解釋為何乘較早的火車；金句指出在預約導賞前有多餘時間。

scene.promptZh: 工作坊十點開始，組員九點四十分已到場並完成登記。哪句最貼切？

options.en: They arrived with time to spare before the workshop.
options.zh: 他們在工作坊開始前提早到達，還有充裕時間。

options.en: They arrived after the workshop had begun.
options.zh: 他們在工作坊開始後才到。

options.en: They reached the desk at exactly ten and had no margin.
options.zh: 他們剛好十點到達登記處，沒有額外時間。

scene.explanationZh: 十點開始、九點四十分已登記，表示開場前有充裕時間；其餘兩句與已給時間不符。

contrast.promptZh: 按本課意思，哪個情況最不適合說 with time to spare？

options.en: A speaker completes the slides half an hour before the meeting.
options.zh: 講者在會議前半小時完成投影片。

options.en: A runner crosses the line exactly at the cut-off, with no time left.
options.zh: 跑手剛好在截止時間衝線，沒有餘下時間。

options.en: A family reaches the airport long before check-in closes.
options.zh: 一家人在辦理登機手續截止前很久便到達機場。

contrast.explanationZh: 剛好在截止時衝線，沒有餘下時間；其餘兩項保留了明顯的時間空間。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「表演七點開始，我們六點十五分就到場了。」哪個回應最自然？

options.en: Great, we have time to spare; let us find our seats calmly.
options.zh: 太好了，我們還有充裕時間；慢慢找座位吧。

options.en: We are definitely late and must ask for a refund.
options.zh: 我們肯定遲到了，必須要求退款。

options.en: There is no need to know when the doors open.
options.zh: 不用知道場館何時開門。

dialogue.explanationZh: 提早四十五分鐘到場，合理地有時間找座位；另外兩句不是根據已知時間作出的合適回應。

speaking.en: We finished the display ten minutes before the doors opened, with time to spare.
speaking.zh: 開門前十分鐘，我們已完成佈置，還有充裕時間。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明佈置完成時為何不用趕。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你明天要到圖書館參加十點開始的講座。巴士車程約三十分鐘，你打算提早出門。用一至兩句英文說明你想怎樣安排到達時間及好處。
writing.selfCheckZh: 說明會在講座開始前到達並留有充裕時間，可用來找場地或登記。

examples.en: I will take an earlier bus so I arrive with time to spare. Then I can find the lecture room.
examples.zh: 我會乘較早的巴士，讓自己提早到達，還有充裕時間。之後便可找講座室。

examples.en: Leaving at nine should give me time to spare before the talk, even if the bus is a little slow.
examples.zh: 九點出門應可讓我在講座前留有充裕時間，即使巴士稍慢也是如此。

glossary.en: the bus is a little slow

takeaways.en: We arrived at the station with time to spare before the last train.
takeaways.zh: 末班火車開出前，我們已到達車站，還有充裕時間。

takeaways.en: She finished the report with time to spare and checked the figures.
takeaways.zh: 她提早完成報告，尚有時間核對數字。

notes: AI-authored first pass; independent editorial and release checks have not occurred.

brief.meaningEn: Be surprised and disadvantaged by an unexpected change or overlooked detail.
brief.meaningZh: 因意想不到的變化或忽略的細節而措手不及、處於不利。
brief.grammar: be caught out by something; a change catches someone out.
brief.register: Common British conversational use; does not necessarily imply dishonesty.
brief.boundaryZh: 須有意外或忽略細節帶來的不利影響；預先知悉並妥善應對，便不是被打個措手不及。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要一律理解成被抓到作弊；本課着重意外變化造成的被動。
brief.outcomeZh: 能辨認突發變化如何使人措手不及，並提出防範方法。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 5, row 7; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Several applicants were caught out by the sudden rule change.

listening.en: The gallery changed its opening hours overnight, and visitors who had not checked the update were caught out.
listening.zh: 畫廊一夜間更改開放時間，沒有查看更新的訪客便措手不及。
listening.promptZh: 部分訪客為何遇到麻煩？

options.en: They did not know about the unexpected change.
options.zh: 他們不知道開放時間突然改變。

options.en: They were caught stealing artwork.
options.zh: 他們被抓到偷畫。

options.en: They had checked the update and changed their plans.
options.zh: 他們看過更新並改了計劃。

options.en: The gallery gave them an extra hour inside.
options.zh: 畫廊讓他們在內多留一小時。

listening.explanationZh: 開放時間一夜間更改，而訪客沒有查看更新，所以到場時措手不及；沒有偷畫的意思。

reply.promptEn: Why do you check the event website on the morning of a trip?
reply.promptZh: （為何出行當早要查看活動網站？）

options.en: I want to confirm the latest opening time.
options.zh: 我想確認最新開放時間。

options.en: I need to see whether any activity has been cancelled.
options.zh: 我需要查看有沒有活動被取消。

options.en: I want to check the address before setting off.
options.zh: 我想出發前核對地址。

options.en: A last-minute change could catch me out if I miss the notice.
options.zh: 如果我錯過通知，臨時變動可能令我措手不及。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都能合理說明出行當早查網站的理由；金句點出錯過臨時通知的風險。

scene.promptZh: 演出臨時改在另一座大樓，沒有看通知的觀眾走錯場地。哪句最貼切？

options.en: They were caught out by the venue change.
options.zh: 場地變動令他們措手不及。

options.en: They had prepared for the new venue and reached it early.
options.zh: 他們已為新場地作好準備並提早到達。

options.en: They were identified as people who had broken a rule.
options.zh: 他們被認定曾違反規則。

scene.explanationZh: 沒有看到臨時場地通知使觀眾走錯地方，符合意外變化造成的不利；不涉及違規。

contrast.promptZh: 按本課「因意外變化措手不及」的意思，哪種情況最不適合說 caught out？

options.en: A student follows an old timetable and misses a moved class.
options.zh: 學生沿用舊時間表，錯過已改時的課堂。

options.en: A team sees the closure notice in advance and takes its planned alternative route.
options.zh: 團隊預先看到封路通知，並按計劃改走另一條路。

options.en: A traveller misses a new luggage rule and pays an extra fee.
options.zh: 旅客沒有留意新的行李規定，須多付費用。

contrast.explanationZh: 預先知悉封路並照計劃改道，沒有被意外變化打個措手不及；另外兩項因忽略更新而受影響。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說：「巴士站突然搬了，我們已在舊站等了十分鐘。」哪個回應最合宜？

options.en: We were caught out by the move. Let us check the new stop and message the group.
options.zh: 站位變動令我們措手不及。先找新站，並通知小組吧。

options.en: The old stop must reopen immediately if we keep waiting.
options.zh: 只要繼續等，舊站一定會立即重開。

options.en: There is no point telling the rest of the group.
options.zh: 不用通知小組其他人。

dialogue.explanationZh: 先承認突發改站帶來被動，再查新站及通知同伴；其餘做法忽視實際問題。

speaking.en: We were caught out by the new entry rule and had to return home for identification.
speaking.zh: 新的入場規定令我們措手不及，須回家拿身分證明文件。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明新規定怎樣影響說話者。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你們準備參觀科技館，卻在門口才知道團體票必須先在網上預約，因此要改天再來。用一至兩句英文說明發生甚麼事及下次如何避免。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出新的訂票要求令隊伍措手不及，並提出下次預先查網頁或預約。

examples.en: We were caught out by the online booking rule and had to return another day. Next time, we will check the website first.
examples.zh: 網上預約規定令我們措手不及，須改天再來。下次我們會先查看網站。

examples.en: The ticket rule caught us out at the entrance, so I will book group tickets before our next visit.
examples.zh: 我們到入口時才因訂票規定措手不及，所以下次參觀前，我會先預訂團體票。

takeaways.en: A sudden timetable change caught us out on the way to school.
takeaways.zh: 時間表突然改變，令我們上學途中措手不及。

takeaways.en: Checking the latest notice can stop a visitor from being caught out.
takeaways.zh: 查看最新通告，可避免訪客措手不及。

notes: AI-authored first pass; independent editorial and release checks have not occurred.

lessons.titleEn: stay one step ahead of delays

brief.meaningEn: Anticipate likely delays and adjust plans before they disrupt you.
brief.meaningZh: 預先留意可能的延誤，並在受影響前調整計劃。
brief.grammar: stay one step ahead of delays; stayed one step ahead of delays.
brief.register: Positive figurative advice; it does not guarantee that every delay can be prevented.
brief.boundaryZh: 須在延誤影響活動前查資訊或採取措施；事後才抱怨不算預先防範。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把 one step 理解成實際多走一步，也不要保證完全不會延誤。
brief.outcomeZh: 能提出事前查證和備用安排，減低延誤的影響。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 5, row 8; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Checking the forecast helps us stay one step ahead of delays.
sources.expression: stay one step ahead of delays

listening.en: By loading parcels before the morning rush, the delivery team stays one step ahead of delays at the warehouse.
listening.zh: 送貨隊在早上繁忙時段前裝好包裹，預先防範貨倉作業延誤。
listening.promptZh: 送貨隊怎樣預防貨倉作業延誤？

options.en: They finish loading before the busiest period can slow them down.
options.zh: 他們在最繁忙的時段拖慢進度前先完成裝貨。

options.en: They reduce the number of parcels but leave the loading time unchanged.
options.zh: 他們減少包裹數量，卻沒有改變裝貨時間。

options.en: They wait for the loading queue to form before beginning.
options.zh: 他們等到裝貨隊伍形成後才開始。

options.en: They guarantee that every parcel will arrive at an exact minute.
options.zh: 他們保證每件包裹都會在某一分鐘準時送達。

listening.explanationZh: 在早上繁忙時段前先裝貨，是事前減低瓶頸影響的行動；這不等於保證每件包裹準時送達。

reply.promptEn: Why are you setting up the school fair tables tonight?
reply.promptZh: （你為何今晚便佈置學校市集的桌子？）

options.en: Visitors can enter promptly when the fair opens.
options.zh: 市集開放時，訪客便可以立即入場。

options.en: The morning volunteers can spend time checking the signs.
options.zh: 早上的義工可以花時間核對指示牌。

options.en: I can check the supplies while the hall is still quiet.
options.zh: 禮堂仍安靜時，我可以核對用品。

options.en: I want to stay one step ahead of delays before the opening rush.
options.zh: 我想在開場的人潮到來前，預先防範延誤。

reply.explanationZh: 四個回應都能合理解釋提前佈置桌子；金句強調在開場人潮出現前做好準備，防範延誤。

scene.promptZh: 學校飯堂知道午餐時段常有長隊，所以在小息前先準備餐盤，並安排多一名收銀員。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The canteen is staying one step ahead of delays by preparing before the rush.
options.zh: 飯堂在人潮到來前先準備，預先防範延誤。

options.en: The canteen waits until the queue grows before preparing any trays.
options.zh: 飯堂等到隊伍變長後才開始準備餐盤。

options.en: The canteen has guaranteed that nobody will ever need to wait.
options.zh: 飯堂保證以後任何人都不用等候。

scene.explanationZh: 人潮到來前已備餐並增派人手，是針對已知瓶頸的事前措施；題目沒有保證完全不用等。

contrast.promptZh: 按本課「在延誤發生前採取措施」的意思，哪種情況最不適合說 stay one step ahead of delays？

options.en: A stage crew tests the microphone and prepares spare batteries before doors open.
options.zh: 舞台組在開門前測試咪高峰，並準備後備電池。

options.en: A crew waits until the microphone fails mid-show before first looking for a battery.
options.zh: 咪高峰在演出中途失靈後，工作人員才首次尋找電池。

options.en: Volunteers print backup entry lists before a busy registration period.
options.zh: 義工在繁忙的登記時段前印好後備入場名單。

contrast.explanationZh: 咪高峰失靈後才首次找電池，屬事後補救；另外兩項是在問題影響活動前準備後備方案。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「明早的展覽可能有很多訪客，同時登記系統偶爾會卡住。」哪個回應最合宜？

options.en: Let us stay one step ahead of delays by testing the scanner and keeping a paper check-in list ready.
options.zh: 我們先測試掃描器，並準備紙本登記名單，預先防範延誤吧。

options.en: Wait until the queue blocks the door before we check the scanner.
options.zh: 等隊伍堵住門口後，才檢查掃描器吧。

options.en: The scanner sometimes freezes, so we can promise every guest instant entry.
options.zh: 掃描器偶爾會卡住，所以我們可保證每位訪客立即入場。

dialogue.explanationZh: 系統偶爾卡住是已知風險；事先測試並備紙本名單，比等人潮形成才處理更合適，也不能保證零等候。

speaking.en: We stayed one step ahead of delays by preparing the registration desk before the first guests arrived.
speaking.zh: 第一批訪客到達前，我們先準備好登記處，預先防範延誤。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明提早準備登記處如何減少延誤。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學校戲劇表演中，兩幕之間只有短時間換裝。你負責後台，擔心換裝會拖慢下一幕。用一至兩句英文說明演出前會做甚麼。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出演出前會標示服裝或準備後備用品，以減低換裝延誤；不要聲稱一定不會延誤。

examples.en: We can stay one step ahead of delays by labelling each costume bag before the performance. That will make costume changes quicker.
examples.zh: 我們可以在表演前替每個服裝袋貼上標籤，預先防範延誤。這樣換裝便會更快。

examples.en: To stay one step ahead of delays between acts, I will keep spare pins and the next costumes beside the stage.
examples.zh: 為了預先防範幕與幕之間的延誤，我會把後備別針和下一套服裝放在舞台旁。

glossary.zh: 替每個服裝袋貼上標籤

takeaways.en: Preparing spare batteries helps a stage crew stay one step ahead of delays.
takeaways.zh: 準備後備電池有助舞台組預先防範延誤。

takeaways.en: The team stayed one step ahead of delays by setting up an extra check-in desk.
takeaways.zh: 團隊增設一個登記處，預先防範延誤。
